items.text:
-become good at hacking
-steal high-rollers space ship
-wander around space station
-hack random doors, steal scrap and sell it
-extort own father for money, convince him to solve it himself and he[i] still [/i]pays me
-try to make friends with Fixer, hates me
-go back to port to start scrapping
-ship despawned
-jump into space and suffocate to death

10/10 would wander around a space station for 4 hours again

realistically i think the game has tons of depth in my 4 small hours of playtime, but i can see the early access showing. hope this gets fleshed out and developed further cause i see tons of potential. 

things i enjoyed:
- diverse ship function systems (i had two saves, both ended in death lmao)
- multiple ways to solve problems whether it be through rerouting power, hacking or prying open various doors and locks
- the skills system seems very interesting once full fleshed out in the later releases of the game
- booting into the ship for the first time really felt like i was coming across an old piece of space junk that[i] somehow [/i] still manages to fly
- the overall atmosphere, with the music and art style combining very well

things i had some issues with were:
- conversations were either hard to discern what to say or entirely oblivion NPC level convos
- the light levels in the game make it very difficult to make out anything that isnt directly next to you
- if i wanted to load a previous save, i had to exit to main menu, then reload
- game seems either difficult or unintuitive to get started with scrapping derelicts
items.text_zh:
-变得擅长黑客
-偷高滚玩家的飞船
-在空间站四处游荡
-黑入随机的门，偷废料并卖掉
-向自己的父亲勒索钱财，说服他自己解决，而他[i]仍然[/i]付钱给我
-尝试与Fixer交朋友，他恨我
-回到港口开始拆解
-飞船消失了
-跳入太空并窒息而死

10/10 会再次在空间站四处游荡4小时

实际上，我认为在我4个小时的短暂游玩时间里，这款游戏有大量的深度，但我能看出早期访问的痕迹。希望这能得到充实和进一步发展，因为我看到了巨大的潜力。

我喜欢的东西：
- 多样化的飞船功能系统（我有两个存档，都以死亡告终，哈哈）
- 多种解决问题的方式，无论是通过重新路由电力、黑客攻击还是撬开各种门和锁
- 技能系统在游戏后续版本中完全充实后似乎非常有趣
- 第一次启动飞船时，真的感觉像是我遇到了一块旧太空垃圾，它[i]不知怎么地[/i]仍然能飞
- 整体氛围，音乐和艺术风格结合得非常好

我遇到一些问题的地方是：
- 对话要么很难辨别该说什么，要么完全是湮灭NPC级别的对话
- 游戏中的光照水平使得很难辨认任何不直接在你旁边的东西
- 如果我想加载之前的存档，我必须退出到主菜单，然后重新加载
- 游戏似乎要么很难，要么不直观，难以开始拆解废弃飞船
